row.evidence: Veeam Data Cloud has no SCIM; its docs say groups let VDC 'automatically grant access and assign roles to users that use Microsoft Entra ID single sign-on (SSO)', creating the account on first sign-in.
row.notes: New row. Researched Veeam Data Cloud (VDC), Veeam's SaaS backup admin portal; Veeam Backup & Replication and other Veeam products are self-hosted software (VBR supports SAML 2.0 SSO for users added by the backup administrator). VDC for Microsoft 365 is priced per protected user: Foundation $2.63 (251+ users), Advanced $3.33, Premium $7.00 per user/mo billed annually; admin seats are not priced separately. VDC sign-in is Veeam My Account or Microsoft 365 ('Continue with Microsoft'), so no SAML with the customer's own IdP is documented (sso_plan null). Provisioning is JIT only: VDC groups mapped to Entra group object IDs create accounts and assign roles at first sign-in; removing the user from the Entra group keeps the VDC account, which must be deleted manually. Okta's Veeam app is SWA only.

plans.name: Foundation (For Microsoft 365)

plans.notes: Priced per protected Microsoft 365 user, not per admin seat.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.price_text: $3.33 USD per user/month billed annually ($3.71 list)

scim.notes: No SCIM in Veeam Data Cloud or anywhere in the Veeam Help Center sitemap (25,553 URLs, none matching scim). VDC admin accounts are invited by email or created just in time from Microsoft Entra ID group membership at sign-in.

audit_log_api.notes: VDC publishes an event reference including Access and Identity events (logins, role changes, account status), but no API for retrieving them was found.

user_api.notes: No public user-management API documented for Veeam Data Cloud. The self-hosted Veeam Backup & Replication product has its own REST API, not assessed here.

okta.notes: OIN search shows the Veeam app tagged SWA only.

entra.notes: VDC signs in with Microsoft 365/Entra accounts ('Continue with Microsoft') and maps Entra group object IDs to roles; no Veeam entry in the Entra SaaS tutorial index.

fallbacks.other_sync: Entra ID group-based access: VDC groups map to Entra group object IDs and assign roles at each sign-in
fallbacks.notes: JIT is via Microsoft Entra ID sign-in (the docs do not name the protocol). Removing a user from the Entra group does not delete the VDC account; deletion is manual and is undone if the user is still a group member.
